<h2 id="Theory">Theory<a class="anchor-link" href="#Theory">¶</a></h2><p>Separate basal transpiration ($K_{cb}$) from soil evaporation ($K_e$). FAO-56 Eq.\ 69:</p>
<p>$$ET_\mathrm{c} = (K_{cb} \, K_\mathrm{s} + K_e) \, ET_0$$</p>
<p>Supporting relations include $K_{\mathrm{c,max}}$ limits, total evaporable water $TEW$, evaporation reduction $K_\mathrm{r}$, and the daily evaporating-layer balance linking $K_e$, $K_{\mathrm{c,max}}$, and wetted fraction $f_\mathrm{ew}$ (Eqs.\ 71--77 in Allen et al., 1998).</p>
</div>
</div>
